def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    person_patches = image_patch.find("person")
    flower_bed_patches = image_patch.find("flower bed")
    
    if not person_patches or not flower_bed_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    person_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in person_patches]
    flower_bed_centers = [(f.left + f.right) / 2 for f in flower_bed_patches]
    
    min_distance = float('inf')
    closest_person = None
    
    for person in person_patches:
        for flower_bed in flower_bed_patches:
            dist = abs(person_centers[person_patches.index(person)] - flower_bed_centers[flower_bed_patches.index(flower_bed)])
            if dist < min_distance:
                min_distance = dist
                closest_person = person
                
    return closest_person
